target_event.description: Brief early hand-to-eye/upper-face relation preceding later longer V/leg-lift gesture

judgments: Check target hand-eye relation, timing/duration, count and order relative to neighboring gestures
Search full output before classifying an event as absent
A later face gesture belonging to long V/leg-lift does not count as early target repair
Additional/elongated face gesture is not faithful restoration
Check appearance/identity, background, adjacent gross motion and artifacts
limitations: Single deliberately selected failure case, one seed, manually chosen window
Nonblind AI visual review; user review useful for subtle gestures
Successful numerical hook is not proof of causal mechanism or video repair
